properties.description: Carga constructores Silver a Gold. Usa Source SQL; constructor_sk es IDENTITY. Verificar nombres de columnas Silver y referencias de datasets.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId) AS constructor_id, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.constructorRef)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS constructor_ref, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])), 100) AS constructor_name, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.nationality)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS nationality FROM silver.constructors c WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_constructor g WHERE g.constructor_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId))',
